name: Skyward Seed
description: Throw a seed of renewing qi that arcs high and drops onto the foe to burst into a shock.

name: Wingbeat Guard
description: Beat the arms once like wings to throw a blow aside on a cushion of renewing air.

name: Thermal Sense
description: Read the warm rising currents of life qi to find hidden or fallen bodies nearby.

name: Lofted Mend
description: Lift an ally on a column of mending qi that closes wounds as the body rises.

name: Thermal Hop
description: Ride a sudden updraft of qi over a foe's low sweep and land behind it.

name: Rebirth Talon
description: Hook a talon of renewing qi through the guard and wrench the wound open.

name: Plume Renewal
description: Shed a fall of bright plumes over allies that carry away poison, taint and curse residue.

name: Skyward Revive
description: Lift a newly fallen ally on a rising wind and call the breath back before the spirit leaves.

name: Azure Resurrection
description: Call back an ally who fell within the length of a short prayer, if the body is whole.

name: Cocoon Shell
description: Spin a tight cocoon of silk qi round the body that takes blows like felt.

name: Silk Poultice
description: Spin a thin cocoon round an ally's wound to hold the edges together and ease the pain.

name: Chrysalis Sense
description: Feel for the slow change under a foe's skin that signals a hidden transformation.

name: Threadcast Lash
description: Cast a loop of silk qi that lashes round the foe's wrists and draws them together.

name: Molt Burst
description: Burst out of a shell of qi and fling its fragments across everyone near the user.

name: Twin Silk Mend
description: Spin a second cocoon inside the first and let it mend torn flesh from within.

name: Pupal Rest
description: Rest inside the cocoon for a few breaths and come out with the reserve refilled.

name: Emerge Strike
description: Burst from the cocoon with a blow that carries the whole stored force of the rest.

name: Cocoon Revive
description: Wrap a newly fallen ally in a cocoon of rebirth qi and wake the stopped heart inside it.

name: Rebirth Wings
description: Unfurl wings of qi and cross the field in a single flash to stand at the foe's back.

name: Cord Tie
description: Tie a thin cord of qi from the user to an ally so strength can pass along it.

name: Twinned Beat
description: Match the user's heartbeat to an ally's so one guard stands over both.

name: Pulse Thread
description: Run a thread of qi along an ally's cord and read the state of their heart.

name: Loaned Breath
description: Breathe in time with a wounded ally and lend them lungs until theirs recover.

name: Lifeline Cut
description: Cut a foe's cord of qi to any ally so the aid they hoped for fails to arrive.

name: Thread Mend
description: Send clean qi down the cord to flush an ally's blood of taint and poison.

name: Lifeline Pull
description: Haul on the cord of a fallen ally and drag the spirit back into the body.

name: Cordlash Crack
description: Whip a taut cord of qi across the foe in a stroke that cracks like a bowstring.

name: Paired Return
description: Call back two fallen allies at once along their twin cords, if both fell within a short while.

name: Former Jab
description: Jab with the memory of a former life's fighting hand and strike where the foe is weak.

name: Carried Name
description: Hold the thread of one's own name firm and keep the body steady under strain.

name: Wind Memory
description: Let the wind carry old memories that name a stranger's school and skill.

name: Breeze Slip
description: Slip along the breeze like a leaf and drop behind the foe's heel.

name: Self Anchor
description: Anchor the self in the breath so that no blow can shake the spirit loose.

name: Former Flurry
description: Throw a flurry of blows learned in earlier lives, each from a different school.

name: Oath Renewal
description: Swear to an ally that they will stand again and let the oath knit the wound.

name: Name Recall
description: Speak a fallen ally's true name into the breath and call the spirit back to it.

name: Wind Reborn
description: Raise a wind of rebirth qi that scours a wide arc and sets the user's wounds to heal.

name: Renewal Vow
description: Swear to rise again and let the vow soak the force of the next heavy blows into new strength.

name: Cycle Patience
description: Feel the slow turning of the cycle in a foe's breath and wait for the weak turn.

name: Rooted Stand
description: Stand rooted and let the qi settle in the bones so the next blow lands dull.

name: Turn Strike
description: Strike at the exact turn of the foe's breath, when the guard is open.

name: Waiting Pulse
description: Wait through a hard exchange while the user's pulse gathers a stored surge.

name: Cycle Bind
description: Wind a slow ring of qi round a foe until their motion matches the ring's pace.

name: Mending Wait
description: Hold still beside a wounded ally and let a patient mend close the hurt turn by turn.

name: Cycle Rise
description: Wait at the turn of the wheel and lift a fallen ally back into the breath at the right moment.

name: Turning Sweep
description: Release the stored turn of the cycle in a broad sweep that knocks all foes down.

name: Cycle Return
description: Take the full force of a blow into the cycle and return it as strength a breath later.

name: Unbroken Link
description: Close a link of qi round a foe's wrist that cannot be pulled apart by force.

name: Wheel Guard
description: Spin a slow ring of qi before the chest and let it grind a blow to nothing.

name: Round Sense
description: Sense the foe's pattern of attacks as a circle and find where the circle will close.

name: Hub Step
description: Pivot on the lead foot as on a hub and swing the body round the foe's strike.

name: Spoke Strike
description: Thrust a straight line of qi like a spoke from the hub into the foe's centre.

name: Turned Force
description: Turn a heavy blow through the wheel and send its force back along the same line.

name: Wheel Mend
description: Roll a wheel of mending qi over an ally's body from foot to crown and close each wound it passes.

name: Ending Recall
description: Turn the wheel back one notch over a fallen ally and recall the moment before the end.

name: Wheel Crush
description: Roll a heavy ring of qi over the foe in a crushing arc that grinds the guard flat.

name: Wheelbound Return
description: Swallow every blow into the wheel and turn each ending into force for the next strike.
